title: Explosions heard in Saudi capital Riyadh, says AFP journalists
summary: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia—Multiple explosions were heard in the Saudi Arabia‘s capital Riyadh on Tuesday, AFP journalists said, following weeks of attacks by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis.…

blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia—Multiple explosions were heard in the Saudi Arabia‘s capital Riyadh on Tuesday, AFP journalists said, following weeks of attacks by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis. Residents received a text-message alert on their mobile phones warning of an “aerial threat” and instructing them to seek shelter. /apl
